items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember the first time you all played together? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Tom Anderson.

ctx.x: Do you remember the first time you all played together? About when it was, or where? Where's it?
Tom Anderson. Was it Tom Anderson? Right across from 25th? Tom Anderson? Yeah.
